scope: All past, current, and future modeling/evaluation phases
governance_rule: Canonical frozen notebooks with accepted SHA-256 hashes are strictly immutable. Retrospective visual companions are created as read-only, non-destructive companions in notebooks/retrospective/. Prospective phases integrate the visual standard directly prior to freeze.

core_requirements.case_selection_policy: Strictly deterministic, prediction-independent, and non-cherry-picked using SHA-256 hash ranking: SHA256('<phase_seed>|' + sample_id). Selection table must be saved prospectively.

mandatory_panels: F. Final prediction overlay on original radiograph
pipeline_specific_panels: Candidate proposal bounding boxes / proposal union

error_map_standard.TP: True Positive (predicted stone overlapping GT stone, coded Green or Cyan)
error_map_standard.FP: False Positive (predicted stone in background tissue, coded Red or Orange)
error_map_standard.FN: False Negative (missed GT stone area, coded Blue or Yellow)

sample_data_visualization.requirement: Every data/modeling notebook must visualize 8-12 deterministic representative samples at the outset.
sample_data_visualization.content: Original image, GT mask, overlay, and clinical metadata (FOV, component count, size stratum).
sample_data_visualization.population_rule: TRAIN or VAL only. Untouched TEST split is strictly forbidden during development.

curves: Markers for best checkpoint epoch, early stopping epoch, and power-resume points

plots: Strata-specific metric bars (Tiny, Small, Medium, Large)
Precision / recall and false positive component distributions
Proposal burden and ROI area fraction distributions

figure_saving_and_size_control.display_method: Saved figures are rendered and embedded into notebook output cells via IPython.display.Image or display(fig), preventing massive raw base64 bloat.

detailed_16_selection.rule: Deterministic SHA-256 ranking of 'phase15_detailed16_seed42|' + sample_id across 106 FULL_FIELD VAL images
detailed_16_selection.pagination: 4 cases per page across 4 pages (16 total)

gallery_75_selection.rule: Deterministic SHA-256 ranking of 'phase15_gallery_seed42|' + sample_id across 106 FULL_FIELD VAL images
gallery_75_selection.pagination: 15 cases per page across 5 pages (75 total)

phase_15_specifications.hard_case_appendix: Independent appendix covering the 16 Hard-Tiny components and 7 Global-Empty images, strictly separated from unbiased 16-case and 75-case cohorts.

test_lock_governance.terminology: Inspection on VAL data must strictly be labeled 'VAL prediction inspection' or 'development visualization'; 'test' is prohibited.
